content.comment_body: Hello all, I'd like to share some insights for those attempting to install [product_name] [version_no] on a newer Mac. I encountered three specific issues during installation that aren't well documented: 1. When extracting the installers (for example, "[product_name]_v[version_no]_macosx.zip" and its inner compressed setup files), it's essential to use The Unarchiver.app. Using Mac OS's default Archive Utility.app leads to a broken installer. 2. The installer needs the correct Java version. Initially, [product_name] [version_no] crashed at launch. I tested Temurin Java 17 and Temurin Java 8 with no luck. It worked only after installing Oracle's Java 8 from [url]. 3. Even with [product_name] [version_no] installed, opening .lsc or .bin files from Finder shows empty diagrams; however, opening the same files from within the [product_name] app loads projects correctly. I can now reprogram my PLCs. Using Windows software in Crossover or a Windows laptop may have been easier, but I got it working on Mac in the end. Hope this helps Mac users! *My setup: Intel Macbook Pro / Mac OS Monterey 12.6.7

analysis.insight_summary: The user details several important steps to successfully install and run [product_name] [version_no] on MacOS Monterey, noting that standard archive utilities do not unpack the installer correctly, Java requirements are confusing, and opening project files directly via Finder leads to blank diagrams. The user succeeds after extensive troubleshooting, highlighting the lack of clear instructions for Mac users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to install and use [product_name] on MacOS easily, with comprehensive documentation and seamless project file handling.
